purpose: Unapproved design concepts; illustrative synthetic content; no application changes

candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. A beautiful portrait mobile WEB APP UI concept for VibeScroll, straight-on screen filling the image, no phone hardware, no hands. Original "Visual collection desk" direction, contemporary editorial light-table: cool pale lavender-white #EEF1F9 canvas, deep indigo ink, rose personal accent and green business accent, small cheerful yellow scroll logo, excellent readable sans serif, precise flat borders and generous whitespace. Visual material supplies beauty, no decorative backgrounds or gradients.
Top VibeScroll with search and initial avatar. Heading "Your library". Two recognizable root tiles "Personal" and "Business" with understated line illustrations. Business active.
Breadcrumb "Business / Product". Below, an automatically arranged vertical stack of nested collection tiles: "Customer experience" with two miniature source cover images, compact collapsed "Pricing", compact collapsed "Marketing". They feel like visual collections, not a chart of circles and not file-manager text rows. Tap the expanded collection reveals ONE selected source card, a small editorial thumbnail and title "Make the next step obvious", badge "Insight", link "View source". No paragraphs.
Under selected insight a simple short connector arrow down to a clear action card: "Simplify shop onboarding", "Demo shop · Proposal", button "Review proposal". Visually demonstrate that a saved idea becomes a project proposal. No fake analytics, counts, prices, testimonials, auto-approval or endless manual canvas.
Bottom native navigation Home, Library active, prominent Save, Projects. Tiny footer "Design concept · illustrative content". Calm attractive coherent UI, useful 44px actions, human and readable, very little explanatory text. Strict exact short labels.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high fidelity portrait MOBILE WEB APP design concept, sharp readable UI, straight-on full screen with no phone hardware or hands. VibeScroll knowledge library, original visual direction called "Vertical knowledge atlas". Polished cool off-white background #F7F9FC, dark navy typography, restrained teal and plum accents, distinctive readable type, excellent spacing. No gradients, no glass, no tiny diagram labels.
Top bar VibeScroll small cheerful yellow scroll mark, search icon, avatar. Title "Your library". Two large root chips horizontally at top: "Personal" and "Business", Business selected in teal. Under them a genuinely VERTICAL expandable knowledge hierarchy, elegant curved thin branches downwards, generous card widths:
Business > Product > Customer experience > "Make the next step obvious". Show only the active branch expanded. Beside Product include collapsed sibling "Marketing". Beside Customer experience include a small collapsed sibling "Pricing". All siblings compact; no wide overflowing row. Selected insight is a beautiful white card with small source thumbnail, concise title "Make the next step obvious", tiny badge "Insight", and a visible "View source" link.
From selected insight card draw one directional arrow DOWN with small label "Used in proposal" to a subtly tinted project proposal card titled "Simplify shop onboarding", subtitle "Demo shop · Proposal", compact status "Ready to review", button "Review proposal". Use strictly illustrative content, no fabricated totals or prices.
Bottom stable mobile navigation Home, Library selected, circular Save button, Projects. Native vertical scrolling implied, no zoom required. Small understated footer "Design concept · illustrative content". This is a real usable app screenshot style design, beautiful hierarchy and human-scale interaction, not a marketing landing page, not a giant graph hairball. Exact short English labels.

Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity WIDE DESKTOP web app UI concept for VibeScroll "Proposal trail". Straight-on exact app screen, no device hardware, no marketing page. Quiet navy #17263E slim left navigation, chalk #F1F4F8 main background, restrained mustard #D9B65A and teal. Beautiful balanced product design with very readable typography and no decorative animation, glass, gradients, code console, or wall of explanatory text.
Left sidebar yellow scroll mark VibeScroll, Home, Library, Projects selected, bottom Connections and avatar. Header breadcrumb "Projects / Demo shop", top search and "+ Save". Title "Simplify shop onboarding", small "Proposal" status.
Main center column is a genuinely VERTICAL source-to-change trail with tasteful thin directional lines and generous spacious connected cards stacked:
1 a compact source card with notebook thumbnail "Saved post", secondary "Make the next step obvious", visible "View source".
2 "Insight" card, exact short claim "Show one clear next step".
3 selected "Proposal" card "Simplify shop onboarding", small status "Ready to review", short evidence link "Why this fits".
4 muted future card "Plan", label "Not approved".
5 muted future card "Change", label "Not started".
Future steps are visibly outlined/unfilled, not checkmarked or completed. No pretend money, benefit or approval.
Right context column header "In your library", Personal and Business chips, active breadcrumb "Business > Product > Customer experience", small selected insight card, then explicit concise review panel: "Review before work starts" followed by three rows "Sources", "Project", "Budget"; button "Review plan". Clearly distinguishes reviewing from running. Nothing actually runs from this design. Footer tiny "Design concept · illustrative content".
Preserve comfortable 44px controls, clean iconography, legible labels, no excessive text or fabricated statistics. Richly composed believable modern app, hierarchy and action trail provide the visual interest.
